no.ingress: Møt Tromsø Fighting Games Community og spill slåssespill sammen.
no.tekst: Hver onsdag møtes Tromsø Fighting Games Community (TFGC) på Tvibit for spillkveld. Spill som Street Fighter, Smash Bros., Tekken og Guilty Gear kan stå på programmet, ofte med turnering. Se TFGCs Discord for oppdatert informasjon.

en.title: Fight Night
en.lead: Meet the Tromsø Fighting Games Community and play fighting games together.
en.text: The Tromsø Fighting Games Community (TFGC) meets at Tvibit on Wednesdays for game night. Games such as Street Fighter, Smash Bros., Tekken and Guilty Gear may be played, often with a tournament. Check TFGC's Discord for current information.
